findings.source_quote: but the end is not yet
findings.suggested_fix: Replace «ولكن ليس المنتهى بعد» with «ولكن النهاية لم تأتِ بعد» or another Arabic rendering that conveys that the end has not yet come.

findings.source_quote: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the contrast as losing one's life for Jesus' sake and finding it; for example: «فمن أراد أن يحفظ حياته يفقدها، ومن يفقد حياته من أجلي يجدها».
findings.translation_quote: فإن من أراد أن يخلّص نفسه يهلكها، ومن يهلك نفسه من أجلي يجدها.

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “First, that which is abroad…”
findings.source_quote: a God who is alive, sovereign, and holy who will some day require an accounting for all things done in this earthly body
findings.suggested_fix: Revise the final clause to say that God will one day require an account of everything done in this earthly body; for example: «إله حيّ وسيد وقدوس سيطلب يومًا حسابًا عن كل ما فُعل في هذا الجسد الأرضي».
findings.translation_quote: إله حيّ وسيد وقدوس، سيطلب يومًا حسابًا عن كل ما فعله الإنسان في هذا الجسد الأرضي

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “What about all the what if ’s…?”
findings.source_quote: then their outcome will be that They are brought down and [are] fallen…
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted result as «هم يخرّون ويسقطون…» (or an equivalent that preserves the subject as those who trusted in chariots and horses).

findings.source_quote: Men’s hearts [are] failing them for fear
findings.suggested_fix: Render this as hearts failing because of fear, for example: «تخور قلوب الناس من الخوف».

findings.source_quote: those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads … should be tormented five months … and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve that the unsealed people are tormented for five months and will long to die but death will flee from them; for example: «أولئك الذين ليس لهم ختم الله على جباههم … يُعذَّبون خمسة أشهر … ويشتهون أن يموتوا، فيهرب الموت منهم».
findings.translation_quote: أولئك الناس الذين ليس لهم ختم الله على جباههم … يُعذَّبون خمسة أشهر … ويطلبون الموت ولا يجدونه

findings.source_quote: Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “my brethren” as «إخوتي» rather than «إخوتي هؤلاء»? Actually preserve its possessive meaning while making clear that the king says the deed was done to him: «بما أنكم فعلتموه بأحد إخوتي هؤلاء الأصاغر، فبي فعلتموه».
findings.translation_quote: بما أنكم فعلتموه بأحد إخوتي هؤلاء الأصاغر فبي فعلتم

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “One specific thing that I wish to focus on…”
findings.suggested_fix: Use an accurate Arabic rendering for the plain communities (the Plain Anabaptist communities), such as «مجتمعات الأنابابتست السهلية», rather than «مجتمعات السهول», which suggests geographic plains generally.

findings.location: HTML, paragraph beginning “For many of us, for me in particular…”
findings.source_quote: What if we were the one who God wanted to say a word for Him out of a life that was living for Him to bring His awareness to one who knows not the One, Living, and True God?
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify the intended idea: God may want us, through a life lived for Him, to speak on His behalf and make Him known to someone who does not know the one true and living God. For example: «ماذا لو كنا نحن الشخص الذي يريد الله أن يتكلم من خلاله بكلمة عنه، في حياة تعيش له، ليعرّف به شخصًا لا يعرف الإله الواحد الحي الحقيقي؟»
findings.translation_quote: ماذا لو كنا نحن الشخص الذي أراد الله أن يقول كلمةً نيابةً عنه، من حياة تعيش له، ليعرّف به شخصًا لا يعرف الإله الواحد الحي الحقيقي؟
